title: Hillenkoetter leaves NICAP as hearings loom
summary: Richard Dolan tells of Hillenkoetter leaves NICAP as hearings loom, about 1962 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: until he resigned suddenly at the moment where in 1962, Donald Kho, his friend, they were trying to get congressional hearings.

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan tells of Roscoe Hillenkoetter, a former head of the CIA, the US spy agency, who sat on the board of NICAP, a private civilian group that pushed for openness about UFOs. Dolan says Hillenkoetter resigned suddenly in 1962, just as his friend Donald Keyhoe, who led the group, was trying to get the US Congress to hold hearings on UFOs. He tells it to suggest pressure was applied to stop those hearings.
